Senses.Explanation: Water holding the moon and mountains wearing clouds joins two natural scenes into a complete couplet of universal inclusion. Puan and Yezhu speak the couplet directly, Qionggu applies it against seeking Chang’an inside its palace, and two unnamed questioners use it as an advance in public exchanges.
